newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Novartis buy of Merck unit good - CSFB.
newsitem.headline: Novartis buy of Merck unit good - CSFB.

text.p: Credit Suisse First Boston hailed Novartis's purchase of Merck & Co's crop protection business, which it called an excellent strategic fit at a resonable price.

"The price of $910 million is a hefty 4.5 times sales but a reasonable nine times EBIT," it said in a research report, adding the deal would boost EBITDA by a slight one to two percent but have no impact on EVA or earnings per share.
The deal helps narrow the gap between Novartis and Bayer, the world leader in insecticides, and is a good geographic fit.
"Furthermore, the Merck products fit well with Novartis' existing products, and their arrival is timely since Novartis' insecticides unit experienced below-average growth in 1996," it said.
